info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Documents-v1-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Documents Retrieval API provides a streamlined method for accessing documents related to job applications submitted through the careers portal. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about application documents, facilitating better management and review processes for Human Resources and recruitment teams. Typical consumers include HR personnel and hiring managers who need to efficiently assess candidate submissions. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their hiring workflows and improve the candidate experience.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents related to applications.
get.description: Fetches all documents associated with the applications in the system. This endpoint allows you to view the necessary documentation for each application, aiding in effective management and oversight.

requestBody.description: Request body containing specifications for retrieving application documents. Must be formatted as per the defined schema.
